en: Āsavasampayuttaduka (The Pair on Being Associated with the Taints)
Dependent on a state associated with the taints (āsava), a state associated with the taints arises by way of the root condition (hetu-paccaya).
Dependent on a state associated with the taints, a state dissociated from the taints arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state associated with the taints, states both associated with the taints and dissociated from the taints arise...
They arise by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state dissociated from the taints (*āsava*), a state dissociated from the taints arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state dissociated from the taints, a state associated with the taints arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state dissociated from the taints (āsava), states both associated with the taints and dissociated from the taints arise by way of the root-condition (hetu-paccaya).
Dependent on a state both associated with the taints and dissociated from the taints, a state associated with the taints [arises].

[Arising] by way of root condition: dependent on a state that is both not associated with the taints (*āsava*) and not dissociated from the taints, a state that is dissociated from the taints arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state that is both not associated with the taints and not dissociated from the taints, states that are both associated with the taints and dissociated from the taints arise by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of the root condition, there are nine; in the object condition, six ... pe ... in the ripening condition, one ... pe ... in the non-disappearance condition, nine. (The full detail applies in all cases.)
